newsitem.title: USA: Bristol Hotel sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Bristol Hotel sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Bristol Hotel Co said on Monday that its directors had authorized a three-for-two stock split in response to increased demand from retail investors for the company's stock.

The split applies to shareholders of record on June 30, who will receive one additional share of stock for each two shares they own on that date, the company said in a statement. Certificates for the new shares will be mailed beginning July 15.

"Our decision to split the stock is in response to the increased demand from retail investors resulting from our recent issuance of 3.2 million additional shares in a public offering," said Bristol president J. Peter Kline.
Bristol Hotel Co owns and operates 98 hotels in 22 states and Canada.
